title: PDF 電子收據生成 + SES 郵件發送 + i18n 收據頁面 (前端+後端)
content: 本卡片擴充原 PR-003 範圍：不僅產收據 PDF 並以 SES 寄出，還要實作收據頁面（取代 demo receipt），支援三語（en/zh-hk/zh-cn），並移除收據頁上的「回到學員儀表板」按鈕。

findings: SES client singleton created: src/lib/aws.ts exports sesClient, sesFromAddress
SES region configured as ap-southeast-1 (Singapore) in APP_SES_REGION
SES from address configured as lmcconsultancy.systems@gmail.com in APP_SES_FROM_ADDRESS
Amplify IAM service role handles SES credentials — no hardcoded access keys needed
evidence.residual: No receipt generation code (@react-pdf/renderer, pdf-lib not yet installed). No SES send-email implementation. No frontend receipt page. No i18n templates. Demo receipt under (portal)/dashboard still uses mock data.

acceptance: 1. PDF receipt template in 3 locales (en, zh-hk, zh-cn) via @react-pdf/renderer — bilingual ZH+EN content per locale
2. Receipt number format: RCPT-{YYYY}-{NNNNN}, auto-incrementing, stored in Registrant.receiptNumber
3. PDF stored in S3: receipts/{receiptNumber}.pdf, password-protected via pdf-lib with registrant's idDocNumber
4. Triggered on admin PATCH /api/admin/enrolments/[id] APPROVE — auto-generate PDF, store, and send
5. SES email via nodemailer: bilingual subject/body per locale, PDF attachment, to registrant's email, BCC admin
6. Frontend receipt page at a Phase 1 route (not under portal) — loads receipt data from DB by receiptNumber or enrolmentId
7. Receipt page UI: LMC letterhead, receipt number, registrant name, course name, fee, payment date, LMC stamp — all 3 locales
8. Receipt page is auto-generated from real DB data — not mock/hardcoded
9. Remove 'Go to Learner Dashboard' button from receipt page
11. Error handling: if SES fails, receipt still stored in S3 and DB — log failure, do not roll back approval
12. Receipt re-download: receipt page provides PDF download button via S3 presigned GET URL
files: src/lib/receipt/generate.ts (new — @react-pdf/renderer template + S3 upload + pdf-lib lock + i18n variants)
src/lib/email/send.ts (new — SES transport from src/lib/aws.ts, bilingual template)
src/app/api/admin/enrolments/[id]/route.ts (update — trigger receipt generation + SES on approve)
src/dictionaries/*.json (update — add receipt page dict keys)
verification: Admin approves enrolment → PDF generated in S3 (password locked with idDocNumber), receiptNumber set in DB, email received with PDF attachment in correct locale. Visit /en/receipt/{enrolmentId} → shows real receipt data from DB, no dashboard link. Same for zh-hk and zh-cn routes.
